sessions.label: Implementing environment permissions OData filter fix

decisions.description: Use a locally loaded Environment array for the permissions dx-list and retain a raised OData MaxNodeCount as a fallback.
decisions.rationale: The UI must not turn selected keys into a large remote OData filter, while other clients still need a bounded server-side fallback.

lessonsLearned.summary: Frontend build cannot run with the installed Node.js version
lessonsLearned.detail: Angular CLI requires Node 24.15.0 or newer; the environment has Node 24.14.1. TypeScript checking also reports a pre-existing missing @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader module.
